## Release impact

The PR title and every commit must follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) — the **Release preview** check shows the version this PR will produce.

- [ ] `fix:` / `perf:` → patch release
- [ ] `feat:` → minor release
- [ ] `feat!:` or a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer → major release
- [ ] `docs:` / `test:` / `ci:` / `chore:` → no release

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test` passes locally
